# Rio Sátira

- Status: preview; Rio-based sensitivity review required
- Center: Arquivo
- Cast: Morador, Motoboy, Olheiro, Tia do Zap, Miliciano, Influencer,
  Comentarista, Laranja, Cabo Eleitoral
- Satirical target: systems of power, manufactured narratives, political files,
  and attention incentives
- Red lines: never equate favela residents or poverty with crime; do not turn
  real violence, victims, race, or named living people into jokes
- Implementation: complete Portuguese copy, timed TTS script, palette, nine
  generated pixel-art character illustrations, and a Rio-specific card back;
  final narration audio and editorial approval remain open
